title: CanonicalError
description: The canonical caller-facing error object (DESIGN §4.3). Wrapped as {"error": CanonicalError} in HTTP error responses, and embedded as-is in request status resources and outbound callback events. Never contains a vendor name, account name or integration/transformer version (D12). Clients MUST treat an unknown `code` by falling back to the HTTP status and `retryable`.

code.description: Canonical error code. DESIGN §4.4 codes plus the hub-public additions listed in contracts/README.md. `IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY` never appears with an HTTP error status (it is signalled by the `X-Hub-Idempotent-Replay` header); `EXPIRED` appears only in request status resources and callbacks.

message.description: Human-readable message. For UPSTREAM_REJECTED this carries the vendor's message passed through (sanitised: no vendor name, no credentials).

retryable.description: Whether the same request may be retried (with the same Idempotency-Key).

retry_after_ms.description: Suggested minimum wait before retrying, in milliseconds. Mirrors the Retry-After response header (which is in seconds, rounded up).

circuit.description: Breaker state seen by this request when relevant (UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE). Not an identifier of any vendor or account.

reason.description: Machine-readable sub-reason. Known values: `circuit_open`, `vendor_5xx`, `vendor_rate_limit`, `account_quota`, `tenant_rate_limit`, `budget`, `paused`, `no_active_version`, `ttl_elapsed`, `attempts_exhausted`, `schema`, `missing_scope`, `not_granted`. New values may be added in minor versions.

upstream.description: Vendor-side outcome, stripped of any vendor identity. Present (possibly with null members) for UPSTREAM_* codes.

status.description: Vendor HTTP status, if a response was received.

code.description: Vendor error code string, if the vendor returned one. Opaque; do not branch on it.

details.description: Field-level details. For VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per violation of the operation's request_schema, with a JSON pointer into the request body; a violation of the declared caller headers has no pointer and its message names the header.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the request body.

request_id.description: The Hub request id (`req_` + ULID). Always present.
